about_li_text: Our commitment is to provide exceptional service, ensuring that each product meets the highest quality standards of quality and sophistication
secrets_tulum_text: Secrets Tulum Resort & Beach Club is a picturesque and romantic adults-only retreat set in a lush green mangrove in Tulum, Mexico.
gran_hyatt_text: Luxurious resort located in the Riviera Maya, Mexico. This five-star hotel is known for its elegant facilities and spacious rooms with stunning views of the Caribbean Sea.
li_viewport_text: Welcome to our convenience store, we offer everything you need during your vacation: groceries, beach items, cell phone accessories, tobacco, medicines, souvenirs, wines, liquors and more. Everything designed to make your stay more comfortable, in My Friend you will find everything you need.
li_about_us_text: In our brand, we offer a unique vacation experience, with luxury products, exclusive designs and impeccable service, always exceeding the expectations of our customers.
li_quality_text: We are committed to offering products of the highest quality, with products that reflect elegance, durability and comfort.
li_heritage_text: We value the history and craftsmanship that define timeless luxury, fusing traditional techniques with innovation to create iconic pieces.
li_service_text: More than a store, we are a destination where service is our top priority.
li_trust_text: Our reputation is based on the trust of our customers, who see our brand as a symbol of prestige and excellence.
li_secrets_tulum_text: Luxurious all-inclusive adults-only resort, located in Tulum. It offers elegant rooms, restaurants and provides an experience of relaxation and luxury in a paradisiacal setting.
li_grand_hyatt_text: Hotel in Playa del Carmen, noted for its luxurious facilities, views of the Caribbean Sea and elegant rooms with various services.
li_hyatt_vivid_text: A new all-inclusive resort awaits you in Cancun, perfect for adults seeking a relaxing and engaging vacation experience in a down-to-earth setting.
